-- Double Bind mission guides: saved objective centers survive model destruction.
local doubleBindCenters=JSON.decode("[[0, -12], [0, 0], [0, 12]]")
local doubleBindGuideGeneration=0
doubleBindBuild=function()
 doubleBindGuideGeneration=doubleBindGuideGeneration+1
 local generation=doubleBindGuideGeneration
 doubleBindGuides={};universalCommit()
 if not doubleBindGuidesEnabled then return end
 local mat=universalMat();if not mat then return end
 local jobs={}
 for _,center in ipairs(doubleBindCenters)do jobs[#jobs+1]={center=center,color={1,.78,.16},points={},top={}}end
 for _,x in ipairs({-4,4})do jobs[#jobs+1]={x=x,color={.83,.35,1},points={},top={}}end
 local index,sample=1,0;local strokes={};local scale=mat.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function step()
  if generation~=doubleBindGuideGeneration or self.isDestroyed()or not universalMat()then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local job=jobs[index]
   if not job then doubleBindGuides=strokes;universalCommit();return end
   local x,z
   if job.center then local a=sample*2*math.pi/96;x=job.center[1]+60/25.4*math.cos(a);z=job.center[2]+60/25.4*math.sin(a)
   else x=job.x;z=-24+sample*.5 end
   local y=universalConfig.surface+.045
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(function()return Physics.cast({origin={x,40,z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=65})end)
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
     local o=hit.hit_object
     if o and hit.point and o.hasTag(universalConfig.tag)and not o.hasTag('mission')and not o.hasTag('controller')and not o.hasTag('NeonSkyTraffic')then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y+.045)end
    end end
   end
   local p=mat.positionToLocal(Vector(x,y,z));job.points[#job.points+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   p=mat.positionToLocal(Vector(x,y+.003,z));job.top[#job.top+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   sample=sample+1
   if sample>96 then
    strokes[#strokes+1]={points=job.points,color={.01,.015,.02},thickness=.13/width}
    strokes[#strokes+1]={points=job.top,color=job.color,thickness=.075/width}
    sample=0;index=index+1
   end
  end
  Wait.frames(step,1)
 end
 step()
end

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Model
ContainedObjects.Nickname: Lantern Market / Midnight blue delivery hovercar
ContainedObjects.Description: Two closed doors, lowered side windows and seated driver. Headlight glow stays with the car; local light sources follow movement, rotation and scaling. Unlock to move. Neon switch controls headlights.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Headlight glow uses car-local vector lines. Two small local light emitters
-- follow positionToWorld, including manual movement, rotation and scaling.
local lamps={}
local timer=nil
local enabled=true
local pending={}
local lampData=JSON.decode("{\"GUID\": \"\", \"Name\": \"Custom_Assetbundle\", \"Transform\": {\"posX\": -5.3, \"posY\": 3.125, \"posZ\": -2.25, \"rotX\": 0, \"rotY\": 0, \"rotZ\": 0, \"scaleX\": 1, \"scaleY\": 1, \"scaleZ\": 1}, \"Nickname\": \"Hovercar headlight / follows parent\", \"Description\": \"Automatically follows its parent car. Invisible light emitter; not terrain.\", \"GMNotes\": \"\", \"ColorDiffuse\": {\"r\": 1, \"g\": 1, \"b\": 1}, \"Tags\": [\"LoboMap:NeonShogunateR4GeneralFinal\", \"light\", \"controller\"], \"Locked\": true, \"Grid\": false, \"Snap\": false, \"IgnoreFoW\": false, \"MeasureMovement\": false, \"DragSelectable\": false, \"Autoraise\": false, \"Sticky\": false, \"Tooltip\": false, \"GridProjection\": true, \"Hands\": false, \"LuaScript\": \"local enabled=true\\nlocal function apply()\\n if self.AssetBundle and self.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffectIndex()~=2 then self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(2)end\\n for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('Light')or{})do\\n  c.set('enabled',enabled);c.set('range',3.0);c.set('intensity',1.7)\\n  c.set('shadows',0)\\n  pcall(function()c.set('color',Color(.82,.94,1,1))end)\\n end\\n for _,r in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('MeshRenderer')or{})do r.set('enabled',false)end\\n for _,kind in ipairs({'BoxCollider','SphereCollider','MeshCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do\\n  for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or{})do c.set('enabled',false)end\\n end\\nend\\nfunction setHeadlight(p)\\n enabled=p==nil or p.enabled~=false\\n if not self.loading_custom then apply()end\\nend\\nfunction onLoad()\\n self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false\\n Wait.condition(apply,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)\\nend\\n\", \"LuaScriptState\": \"\", \"XmlUI\": \"\", \"CustomAssetbundle\": {\"AssetbundleURL\": \"https://cdn.steamusercontent.com/ugc/2270444915139308921/D2EDFE1A528B36A7EBBC59B35772D04542F981FA/\", \"AssetbundleSecondaryURL\": \"\", \"MaterialIndex\": 3, \"TypeIndex\": 0, \"LoopingEffectIndex\": 2}}")
local sockets={{3.05,.53,-.63},{3.05,.53,.63}}
local function ownTag(g)return 'NeonCarHeadlight:'..g end
local function removeTag(g)
 for _,o in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag(ownTag(g)))do if o and not o.isDestroyed()then o.destruct()end end
end
local function glow()
 local lines={}
 if enabled then
  for _,socket in ipairs(sockets)do
   local pts={}
   for i=0,20 do local a=i*math.pi/10;pts[#pts+1]={2.932,.53+math.cos(a)*.047,socket[3]+math.sin(a)*.047}end
   lines[#lines+1]={points=pts,color={.82,.95,1},thickness=.022}
  end
 end
 self.setVectorLines(lines)
end
local function update()
 if self.isDestroyed()then return end
 for i,socket in ipairs(sockets)do
  local lamp=lamps[i]
  if lamp and not lamp.isDestroyed()then
   lamp.setPosition(self.positionToWorld(socket))
   lamp.setRotation({0,0,0})
   lamp.call('setHeadlight',{enabled=enabled})
  end
 end
end
local function mount()
 if self.isDestroyed()then return end
 local found=getObjectsWithTag(ownTag(self.getGUID()))
 for _,o in ipairs(found)do
  local n=tonumber(o.getGMNotes())
  if n and n>=1 and n<=2 and not lamps[n]then lamps[n]=o else o.destruct()end
 end
 for i,socket in ipairs(sockets)do
  if not lamps[i]and not pending[i]then
   local data=JSON.decode(JSON.encode(lampData))
   data.Tags={ownTag(self.getGUID()),'NeonCarLightHelper'};data.GMNotes=tostring(i)
   local p=self.positionToWorld(socket)
   data.Transform.posX=p.x;data.Transform.posY=p.y;data.Transform.posZ=p.z
   pending[i]=true
   local index=i
   spawnObjectJSON({json=JSON.encode(data),sound=false,callback_function=function(o)
    pending[index]=nil
    if self.isDestroyed()then o.destruct();return end
    lamps[index]=o;update()
   end})
  end
 end
 glow();update()
 if timer then Wait.stop(timer)end
 timer=Wait.time(update,.10,-1)
end
function setNeon(p)
 enabled=p==nil or p.enabled~=false
 glow();update()
end
function onLoad(saved)
 if saved and saved~=''then local ok,state=pcall(function()return JSON.decode(saved)end);if ok and state.enabled~=nil then enabled=state.enabled end end
 self.setLock(true)
 Wait.condition(mount,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)
end
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 removeTag(oldGuid)
end
function onSave()return JSON.encode({enabled=enabled})end
function onDestroy()
 if timer then Wait.stop(timer)end
 removeTag(self.getGUID())
end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
local lightConfig=JSON.decode("{\"range\":3.0,\"intensity\":1.85,\"color\":{\"r\":1,\"g\":0.63,\"b\":0.32,\"a\":1}}")
local enabled=true
local function apply()
 if self.isDestroyed()then return false end
 local components=self.getComponentsInChildren('Light')or{}
 if self.AssetBundle then
  local target=enabled and 2 or 0
  if self.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffectIndex()~=target then self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(target)end
 end
 for _,component in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('Light')or{})do components[#components+1]=component end
 for _,c in ipairs(components)do
  c.set('enabled',enabled)
  c.set('range',lightConfig.range)
  c.set('intensity',lightConfig.intensity)
  c.set('shadows',0)
  pcall(function()c.set('color',Color(lightConfig.color.r,lightConfig.color.g,lightConfig.color.b,lightConfig.color.a))end)
 end
 for _,renderer in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('MeshRenderer')or{})do renderer.set('enabled',false)end
 for _,kind in ipairs({'BoxCollider','SphereCollider','MeshCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do
  for _,collider in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or{})do collider.set('enabled',false)end
 end
 return true
end
function setNeon(p)
 enabled=p==nil or p.enabled~=false
 apply()
end
local function refresh()
 if self.isDestroyed()then return end
 local controller=getObjectFromGUID('e80124')
 if controller then enabled=controller.getVar('neonEnabled')~=false end
 apply()
end
function onLoad(saved)
 self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false
 if saved and saved~=''then local ok,s=pcall(function()return JSON.decode(saved)end);if ok and s.enabled~=nil then enabled=s.enabled end end
 Wait.condition(refresh,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)
 Wait.frames(refresh,120)
end
function onSave()return JSON.encode({enabled=enabled})end

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Model
ContainedObjects.Description: Large portrait rooftop advertising. Automatically changes approved artwork every 25 seconds. All thirteen artworks share one cached atlas; initial mesh loading still depends on TTS. Hides when its host roof is removed.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
local cfg=JSON.decode("{\"image\": 11, \"interval\": 25, \"controller\": \"e80124\", \"hostRoof\": \"e80167\", \"lines\": [{\"points\": [[-1.825, 1, -0.19], [-1.825, 6.0, -0.19], [1.825, 6.0, -0.19], [1.825, 1, -0.19], [-1.825, 1, -0.19]], \"color\": [1, 0.12, 0.7], \"thickness\": 0.045}]}")
local neon=true
local cycleTimer=nil
local visibilityTimer=nil
local allColors={'White','Brown','Red','Orange','Yellow','Green','Teal','Blue','Purple','Pink','Grey','Black'}
local function hostVisible()
 return cfg.hostRoof==nil or getObjectFromGUID(cfg.hostRoof)~=nil
end
local function refresh()
 if self.isDestroyed()then return end
 local show=hostVisible()
 self.setInvisibleTo(show and {}or allColors)
 self.setVectorLines(show and neon and cfg.lines or {})
 for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('MeshCollider')or{})do c.set('enabled',show)end
end
local function change()
 if self.isDestroyed()then return end
 if hostVisible()then self.setState(cfg.image%13+1)
 else cycleTimer=Wait.time(change,cfg.interval)end
end
function setNeon(p)neon=p==nil or p.enabled~=false;refresh()end
function onLoad(saved)
 self.setLock(true)
 local controller=getObjectFromGUID(cfg.controller)
 if controller then neon=controller.getVar('neonEnabled')~=false end
 refresh()
 cycleTimer=Wait.time(change,cfg.interval)
 visibilityTimer=Wait.time(refresh,.5,-1)
end
function onDestroy()
 if cycleTimer then Wait.stop(cycleTimer)end
 if visibilityTimer then Wait.stop(visibilityTimer)end
end
